title: Topic 12
japanese_text: ペットの<u>しつけ</u>をする際は、おびえさせず、<u>親近感</u>をもたせることが重要だ。また、何かできたときはすぐご褒美を与えると効果的だ。
english_translation: When training a pet, it is important not to frighten it, but rather build an affinity with it. Giving your pet a reward when it succeeds in doing something is also effective.
